speech_de: Auf geht's, zurück in die Reihe!
scenario: A big, friendly, round Cancer Cell character (a plump wobbly circle with a few gentle bumps and one oversized round nucleus-face — one eye a little bigger than the other, a happy open smile, sweet and slightly muddled, never sad or sick) holds hands with a smaller, neat, normal Cell character beside it. Behind them a cheerful curved line of more small round normal Cell characters link hands in a friendly parade sweeping up and off the top/right of the frame, welcoming the big wobbly cell to join the line. Gentle round blob 'tissue' scenery fills the rest. No fighting, no weapons, no medical tools, no tears — just a muddled cell being helped back into line.
